notes.title: Playtest #2
notes.content: [h2]Yo Playtesters,[/h2][h3]I want to cordially invite you all to come and join us this [b]Saturday 9/6/2025 from 5pm-8pm PDT[/b] for our 2nd playtest.  Oh, and don't forget to clip your plays, they're a ton of fun to watch as they really showcase the gameplay.  You can post them in our Discord or Subreddit  to share with the community (links on our store page).  Maybe we'll vote to see which is the best one.  You can also post bugs (hopefully there are none) there too.[/h3][h3]I'll see you in net...bring it,[/h3][h3]Harper[/h3]

notes.title: Hang in there...
notes.content: [p]We will be posting a new date as soon as possible.  Thank you for your understanding.[/p]

notes.title: PLAYTEST - Today, Tomorrow & Saturday! EXTENDED to Sunday
notes.content:
[h1]YO, you ready to go COAST TO COAST?  We are![/h1][p][/p][h3][b]UPDATE: Extended to Sunday, starting now - ending TBD.  Join the Discord for more details.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]After the anticipated one week wait, we are scheduling 3 playtest times. One today (7/31), one tomorrow and one on Saturday starting at 1:30pm PDT and ending at 4pm PDT.  The first 30 minutes are reserved for our playtest team (THAT'S YOU) to download and [b]PRACTICE[/b] (Goalie is one of the goated positions) the Hockey Club Playtest which will show up in your Library as a separate game.  The DOWNLOAD LINK (you may need to logout/log back into steam) is found on our [u][b]STORE PAGE[/b][/u] where you first signed up to playtest:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685051/7d9bb1784f9159e8b83622a293b87d53e995c739.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]GAME MATCH UPs will begin at 2pm PST and continue until 4pm PST, for each of these days.  The Hockey Club Playtest is found in your [u][b]LIBRARY[/b][/u] after download:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685051/877cf85c935ed8eec029855def782d72fc416ce6.png"][/img][/p][p]Remember when we mentioned some of our Beta Test gamers were better than us?  WELL, NOT ANYMORE...we are kind of sweaty at our game...if you sell the match, YOU'RE BANNED! ːsteamsaltyː[/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we are also working on a notification system for letting our Playtest Team know when these Playtests will be made available.  Details on that are coming...  Oh, and to our Friends in other Countries (non-USA), bear with us, we will figure something to help you out! [/p][p][/p][p]'til then...SEE YOU ON THE ICE,[/p][p][/p][p]Harper[/p]

notes.title: We're about to HIT THE TAPE!
notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]First a quick [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all that have, and are continuing, to sign up, for access to the playtest!  We are getting amazing response, which keeps ramping up, and are working feverishly to maintain that pace.[/p][p][/p][p][b]LAST TUESDAY NIGHT[/b] for a couple hours we opened an [b]impromptu[/b] (unannounced) playtest, along with us and our Closed Beta Test team, and had really exciting results.  From that a few issues popped up that we are currently fixing.[/p][p][/p][p]Once fixed, we will be, [u]announcing this time[/u], a scheduled playtest event during a certain timeframe so [b]EVERYONE[/b] can get a heads up and plan to be on, ready to play![/p][p][/p][p]We're thinking of giving everyone around the [b]first 30 minutes[/b] to download, practice the controls (trust...you will need it) and perhaps setup your customized position builds, before we start in on [u]approximately a 2 hour PvP online play[/u] which will include ourselves (3 devs) and our Beta Test Team.[/p][p][/p][p]For the smaller countries, you may need to adjust your players per team down to say 3v3 or whatever until the player base has expanded to facilitate a larger game.  The larger countries, should be fine finding players for a game, however we are unable to predict peoples schedules.  So we encourage everyone who has signed up for access to [b][u]TELL THEIR FRIENDS[/u][/b] so that the larger the player base the better chance of getting a full game going especially at this early phase.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again and KEEP THAT STICK ON ICE![/p][p][/p][p]Harper[/p]

notes.title: Pre-launch/Closed Beta Test Patch - v0.0.1
notes.content: [p]Hey All,[/p][p][/p][p]We added a single player practice rink with a Help Menu, where you can test your builds per position.  This was well received by our beta test team!  Because of the complexity of the controls, our team welcomed this mode in order to become familiar with all the functionality under-the-hood.  Initially, some of our more seasoned "giga-gamers," we introduced to Hockey Club, were a bit daunted by the functionality, but after 8 hours of explaining things, they started playing better than us!  WHAT!!!![/p][p][/p][p]I guess WE need to put in more practice...can't wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, we'll call this patch 0.0.1, in order to create a start and keep track of our progress to launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Check back often and I'll keep you all posted...thanks and take care,[/p][p][/p][p]Jason ("Harper")[/p][p]Developer (1 of 3) of Hockey Club[/p]

notes.title: Beginning Closed Beta Testing
notes.content: [p]Hey, this is Jason from Boogerman Games.  Last Saturday, we started with a closed beta testing group, and received tremendous feedback so far.  We are currently working through the fixes and adjustments expressed by our team, as well as a bunch of ideas we can't wait to add in to the game.  I'll be updating our progress on a regular basis for launch, so be sure to check back regularly.[/p][p][/p][p]Hang On Tight!  We're about to go BAR DOWN![/p][p][/p][p][/p]
